newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court says Belgium late to enact dangerous substances rules.
newsitem.headline: Court says Belgium late to enact dangerous substances rules.

text.p: The European Court of Justice said on Thursday Belgium was late to enact five directives relating to dangerous substances.

Belgium did not deny its failure to transpose the directives, but observed it was first necessary to amend an existing royal decree and that draft legislation was currently awaiting ministerial signature.
(Court translation into English. Original language of the case: French)
"Failure to fulfil member state obligations - Failure to transpose directives 92/32/EEC, 92/69/EEC, 93/86/EEC and 93/105/EEC"
Commission of the European Commission, applicant
application for a declaration that, by not adopting or not communicating within the prescribed time limit the laws, regulations, and administrative provisions necessary to comply with

Council directive 92/32/EEC of 30 April 1992 relating to classification of dangerous substances; Council directive 92/69/EEC of 31 July 1992 adapting to technical progress for the seventeenth time Council directive 67/548; Commission directive 93/67/EEC of 20 July 1993 relating to risks to man and the environment from dangerous substances; Commission directive 93/86/EEC of 4 October 1993 and Commission directive 93/105/EC of 25 November 1993 relating to the technical dossier for Council directive 67/548/EEC
the Kingdom of Belgium has failed to fulfil its obligations under the EC Treaty.
1. By not adopting or not communicating within the prescribed time limit the laws, regulations, and administrative provisions necessary to comply with

Council directive 92/32/EEC of 30 April 1992 relating to classification of dangerous substances; Council directive 92/69/EEC of 31 July 1992 adapting to technical progress for the seventeenth time Council directive 67/548; Commission directive 93/67/EEC of 20 July 1993 relating to risks to man and the environment from dangerous substances; Commission directive 93/86/EEC of 4 October 1993 and Commission directive 93/105/EC of 25 November 1993 relating to the technical dossier for Council directive 67/548/EEC

the Kingdom of Belgium has failed to fulfil its obligations under article 3 of directive 92/32, article 3 of directive 92/69, article 8 of directive 93/67, article 7 of direcctive 93/86 and article 2 of directive 93/105.
2. The Kingdom of Belgium is ordered to pay the costs.
